newsitem.title: USA: Arizona voters back lottery measure -- final tally.
newsitem.headline: Arizona voters back lottery measure -- final tally.

text.p: An Arizona initiative that would allocate $17 million annually to fund health and nutrition programs passed Tuesday, according to election returns.
Proposition 203, which would allocate the funds from lottery revenues, had 71.9 percent support, while 28 percent were opposed, with 99.2 percent of the precincts reporting.
Proposition 201, which would amend gambling agreements between the state and Indian tribes, won approval by 64 percent to 35.9 percent, election officials said.

Proposition 101, which would allow the legislature to exempt from taxation the first $50,000 of the value of personal property that is used for agricultural purposes or in a trade or business, passed with 51.2 percent to 48.7 percent.
